dedupe_keys.name: ribuild material properties for historic building materials and insulation materials

description: RIBuild partners compile material properties of historic building materials and insulation systems for internal retrofits. The first group of spreadsheets assembles materials from partner countries, seeking data absent from the DELPHIN database but required for its simulations. Further sheets characterise specific Italian and Swiss historic materials, with measurements performed at Riga Technical University. Zenodo supplies eleven XLSX files freely under CC BY 4.0. These are source-defined material inputs for hygrothermal building simulations, not completed building performance results. A limitation is that the metadata does not enumerate every parameter, unit, test method or uncertainty value; these details remain unverified without opening the spreadsheets. Geographic labels describe material provenance and project coverage, not universal validity. The related RIBuild historic-building survey describes building stock and renovation examples, while this resource provides the separately published material-property inputs.
